observation.command: echo "=== FINAL STATE $(date) ==="; echo "--- containers ---"; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "--- dev servers (direct) ---"; for p in 34237 35581 38377; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>&1); echo "127.0.0.1:$p -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}"; done
